tools.name: get_you
tools.description: Get the account the current token authenticates as, including whether it is a client account (clients cannot create environments), whether a git account is connected, which git installation accounts can be used as the owner part of a repository argument, and the next boarding step the person has to take in the dashboard. During sign-up, show next.instruction and next.url to the person and call get_you again until next.step is ready.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List regions an app can be created in. Use the identifier value as the region argument of create_app.

tools.name: list_software_presets
tools.description: List software presets an app can be created with, including the major versions each preset supports. Use the slug value as initialEnvironment.softwarePresetName and a versions entry as initialEnvironment.softwareVersion in create_app.

tools.name: list_git_repositories
tools.description: List the GitHub repositories the authenticated user can deploy from. Use the fullName value ("owner/repo") as the git repository argument of create_app, and defaultBranch as the branch when none is specified.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List apps accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: List environments accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List domains accessible to the authenticated user, including custom apex and subdomain entries, cloud domains, and the default domain of every environment.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List teams accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_payment_methods
tools.description: List payment methods accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_component_plans
tools.description: List every component, whether it is optional, and the plan sizes available for it with their specs and monthly price. Use the returned slug and size values as the components argument of create_app and create_environment; "off" disables an optional component.

regionIdentifier.description: Region identifier, e.g. "eu-w1a". Supply it to receive prices; without it priceInCents is null.

tools.name: list_git_branches
tools.description: List the branches of a GitHub repository the authenticated user can deploy from. Use a name value as the git branch argument of create_app or create_environment.

tools.name: detect_repository_stack
tools.description: Detect the framework and version of a GitHub repository and, when it matches one, the fortrabbit software preset to create the app with. Call it before create_app to choose initialEnvironment.softwarePresetName instead of guessing.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Get an accessible app by public ID.

publicId.description: Public ID of the app, e.g. "ap-a1b2c3".

tools.name: get_environment
tools.description: Get an accessible environment by public ID.

publicId.description: Public ID of the environment, e.g. "en-a1b2c3".

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.description: Get an accessible deployment by public ID.

publicId.description: Public ID of the deployment, e.g. "dp-a1b2c3".

tools.name: get_deployment_logs
tools.description: Get the build and deploy log lines of an accessible deployment. Use it to find out why a deployment failed after create_app started one.

publicId.description: Public ID of the deployment, e.g. "dp-a1b2c3".

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: Get an accessible domain by public ID, including cloud domains and default domains.

publicId.description: Public ID of the domain, e.g. "do-a1b2c3".

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Get an accessible team by public ID.

publicId.description: Public ID of the team, e.g. "tm-a1b2c3".

tools.name: get_payment_method
tools.description: Get an accessible payment method by public ID.

publicId.description: Public ID of the payment method, e.g. "pm-a1b2c3".

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List deployments accessible to the authenticated user, newest first. total counts all matching deployments; raise offset to page back through older ones.

environmentPublicId.description: Return only the deployments of this environment.

tools.name: create_app
tools.description: Create a trial app and its initial environment. The app has no payment method: it is deleted at the end of the trial unless the person adds one in the dashboard. Call list_regions and list_software_presets first to discover valid values.

teamPublicId.description: Public ID of the owning team. Omit for a personal app.

initialEnvironment.description: softwarePresetName, softwareVersion, cloudDomain, components, autoscaling, deployment {git, buildCommands, postDeployCommands}.

tools.name: create_environment
tools.description: Create an environment in an accessible app. Either supply component plans for every required component, or set sourceEnvironmentPublicId to clone an existing environment. Refused on an app with a payment method, because the environment would be billed: the error links to the dashboard, where the person creates it.

appPublicId.description: Public ID of the app, e.g. "ap-a1b2c3".

sourceEnvironmentPublicId.description: Environment to clone component plans from.

tools.name: update_environment
tools.description: Change settings on an accessible environment. Only the arguments you supply are changed; everything else is left untouched. Environment variables are merged, not replaced: Add or change a variable by sending its name with a string value. Remove a variable by sending its name with a null value. Variables you do not name are left unchanged; omit the field entirely to change nothing. Platform-injected variables cannot be added, changed or removed. Call get_environment first to see the current values.

publicId.description: Public ID of the environment, e.g. "en-a1b2c3".

environmentVariables.description: String adds or changes a variable, null removes it.
